{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Down with the flesh! Machine is terror! Terror is art! Art is the new Empire!|C-3PO|<ref name=":1" />}}
The '''Stygian Art''' was a technique devised by the former [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] known as [[Cronal]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. 

== History ==
{{Quote|Art will transform the galaxy!|Perek|<ref name=":1" />}}
In the aftermath of his failed [[Battle of Mindor|campaign]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], [[Cronal]] forsook his [[Sorcerers of Rhand|Rhandite]] [[Way of the Dark|philosophy]] and sought to find his [[Sariss|daughter]] to beg for her forgiveness. Upon finding her [[Death/Legends|dead]] body on [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]], his guilt and heartbreak caused him to loose all grip on reality. He abandoned his philosophy of entropy and wholly embraced the [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith]] art of ''[[mechu-deru]]''. He began blending technology with [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alcehmy]] to therapeutically sow creation from the seed of destruction, dubbing this process "Stygian art".<ref name=":0">{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-3|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 3|nolive=1}}</ref> 

While residing on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trailia]], Cronal spent a number of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] experimenting with Stygian Art by "resculpting" the [[Trailian|native inhabitants]]. He spent many years performing these permutational experiments. Among the creations spawned from these experiments included a group of [[Trailian technobeast|technobeasts]]. He eventually abandoned the world in favor of the bowels of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was there that fellow Emperor's Hand [[Roganda Ismaren/Legends|Roganda Ismaren]] contracted him to transform her son [[Irek Ismaren|Irek]] into a colossal cyborg. Cronal forged him into an artistic masterpiece, but his subject was too unstable and he was forced to lobotomize him with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name=":0" /> 

Cronal fled to an abandoned [[Droid/Legends|droid]] depot on the industrial world [[Andooweel/Legends|Andooweel]] and styled himself as a cyber-artist named Perek. His next project was to create an "[[Empire of Art]]". He developed an "[[Art virus]]"<ref name=":1">''[[Collapsing New Empires|"Collapsing New Empires" — ]][[Star Wars Tales 19]]''</ref> that worked similarly to the [[Nanogene spore|Nanogene]] [[Nanogene droid|technovirus]] developed by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lady]] [[Belia Darzu]].<ref>''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> Flesh was used as fuel for the virus as it transmuted living tissue into mechanical parts. Perek collected equipment and personnel from the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|remnants]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] and transformed them into works of art. Vehicles and equipment were turned into sculptures and art installations, while the troops were infected with his virus and transformed into technobeasts. He then abducted at least a dozen [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawlers]] worth of [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] and infected them with his virus. The clouds of insects that covered the Jawas' faces were also infected with the virus and were transformed into micro-droids. Perek planned to use this technobeast army to infect the galaxy with his virus and build it into an Empire of Art.<ref name=":1" />

While [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] served the [[Cloning/Legends|reborn]] [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], his [[Cybernetics/Legends|prosthetic]] hand was replaced by one polluted with ''mechu-deru''. In [[15 ABY/Legends|15 ABY]], his alchemically-altered appendage instinctively drew him to Andooweel. While a team consisting of Luke, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] interrogated Perek, [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] stayed behind on the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. Perek's micro-droids boarded the ship and transformed the two droids into Stygian monstrosities. When the team returned to the Falcon, they defeated a group of technobeast Jawas and discovered Perek's dark secret. They were then captured by R2-D2 and C-3PO so Perek could harvest their bodies. The micro-droids attacked Luke and infected the circuitry of his prosthetic hand with the Art virus. The virus precipitated a monstrous metamorphosis in Luke's hand. Once the infection spread up Luke's arm to the rest of his body, he would become more machine than man, just like his [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|father]].<ref name=":1" /> This would be Perek's most magnificent creation, a perfect vessel for him to [[Essence transfer|possess]].<ref name=":0" /> Before this could occur, Luke tracked Perek down, strangled the sorcerer to death with his infected arm, and cut it off before the virus could reach the rest of his body. Han Solo and Chewbacca crafted a [[Corellian spark grenade]] and short-circuited the rest of Perek's creations.<ref name=":1" />
